mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that potentiate nifedipine's cardiac effects and increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium) regularly, perform baseline and periodic ECG monitoring, and consider alternative antiviral if possible; adjust nifedipine dose if electrolyte disturbances occur.
